That move matters because a scale is not just a neutral container waiting for judgment to be poured into it. If its levels are vague, different evaluators can divide the same performance differently. Performance ratings make that variation especially visible because the scale is where evaluative distinctions have to land.

This is where the scale matters as structure. Defining it more clearly can help evaluators separate one level from another with less avoidable drift. The gain is not that judgment disappears. The gain is that distinctions stop being so underdescribed.
